Morning everyone. Welcome to our monthly Zoom meeting.
How are we all doing today?
Morning Shane. I'm feeling great so far.
Thank you. I wish I could say the same, David.
We have quite a bit going on at the moment, so it’s been a busy period for me.
Let's get right into it then, shall we?
Actually, The Guided Nature Walk at the Hong Kong Wetland Park is coming up soon.
Have we finalised all the details yet?
Yes. The Guided Nature Walk will be held on the 27th of April at 10am.
OK, April 27th at 10am.
A very sensible time to meet.
And, as usual, the walk will be 2 hours long.
2 hours? was?
Sounds about right.
Is the meeting venue still the main entrance of the park?
No, we decided that the main entrance is much too busy.
The meeting venue this time will be the visitor centre.
I agree: the visitor centre is a much better choice.
Another sensible decision!
We'll email all the details to the participants soon.
Now that all the details of The Guided Nature Walker finalised, shall we move on to the Bird Watching Tour at the Hong Kong Botanical Gardens?
I think we're planning to write an email to Peter Chan, the manager of the Botanical Gardens.
Yes. I remember that this is a tour we tend to start bright and early in the morning.
7: 30am, isn’t it?
I believe that’s not the case anymore, Shane.
Am I right, Avery?
Yes David, you're right.
We're changing the time of the Bird Watching Tour from 7: .30 AM to 9: .30 AM.
We need to inform Peter Chan of this change in the email.
From 7: .30 AM to 9: .30 AM?
Hmm. that’s quite a big change.
I’m sure Peter will want to know why.
What will you tell him in the email?
Well, we have some important reasons for the change in time.
Quite simply, not enough people are signing up to join the Bird Watching Tour.
Clearly it’s a big problem if there are not enough people signing up to join the Bird Watching Tour.
We definitely want to increase the number of people signing up.
So, you think this is because the Tour starts too early?
Exactly Exactly right.
Actually, we’ve had complaints from participants in previous tours that the Bird Watching Tour starts too early.
OK, I see.
Well, if we've had complaints that the Tour starts too early, then changing the time is the right decision.
I suppose an early start isn’t for everyone!
That's settled, then.
Anything else I need to know about the tour?
No, I think that’s it.
Alright then. Let’s move on to a slightly less fortunate topic.
Are you referring to the accident the World City Travel catamaran was involved in?
Captain Moby is a good friend and I heard a little bit about it from him.
Yes David, you're right.
I was referring to the catamaran accident in Sydney Harbour.
Such a shame.
The catamaran is such a beautiful boat I hope the damage wasn’t too bad.
Well, speaking of which, we need to write the incident report.
How’s the Review Board’s investigation on Captain Moby going?
Have they reached a conclusion yet?
That's the good news.
I’ve been sent the results of the Review Board’s investigation and the conclusion is that Captain Moby is not at fault.
Captain Moby not at fault He will be so relieved to hear that.
that. That’s not all, David.
The Review Board has also insisted that we explicitly mention in the incident report that Captain Moby was extremely professional in handling the situation.
Oh wow, he must have done an amazing job for them to say that.
But then, knowing Captain Moby, I’m not surprised.
He is indeed extremely professional We're lucky to have him with our company.
The accident also caused the cancellation of the next Sydney Whale Watching Cruise.
We've informed the participants about the cancellation, but we need to write a follow -up email to them.
We should talk about compensation.
Of course. Reputation is everything in our business.
And I don’t want people to have a bad impression of us because of this incident.
it. So, I want to go the extra mile for this.
As part of the additional compensation package, on top of what we’ve pledged already, we'll be giving participants at the cancelled cruise lifetime membership of World City Travel.
Lifetime membership of World City Travel?
What does that include?
It’s a great deal.
With lifetime membership, participants can get a 30 % discount on all all tours that we provide.
For life! 30 % off is an amazing deal.
How can I get lifetime membership?
Well, hopefully that will help us put all this behind us.
We have a lot to look forward.
to with our new Insects and Reptiles Exhibition.
Yes, that’s right.
We need to continue promoting the new Insects and Reptiles exhibition.
David, David, you had an idea about the dragonflies in the exhibition.
Can you tell us a bit more?
Of course. Generally people see a lot of dragonflies around Hong Kong, especially in parks.
But we have two very special ones people will encounter at the exhibition.
And they are?
Well, first we will have the Red Baller at the exhibition.
And along with that, people get to see the bluetail.
You can see pictures of them on the website.
Red balla and bluetail.
Those are very interesting names for very interesting dragonflies!
They are. And to encourage people to look out for them, we will also have a photo taking competition.
Oh yes, you told me about this photo -taking competition when we were at lunch last week.
week. I think you said the best dragonfly photo wins 500 Yes, that’s right: the participant with the best dragonfly photo wins 500 This should add a little excitement for the participants.
I didn’t know you two were meeting for lunch now!
What next? Anyway, there is one last Thank you.
want to talk about before we wrap up the meeting.
Our new Adventure Fishing Tour starts soon in Sydney.
Last time, we discussed adding stops along the route, What became of that, Avery?
Right. So, during the Adventure Fishing Tour, the yacht will stop at two white sand beaches.
Two white sand beaches?
Any particular reason for this choice?
Why not on some sort of outlying islands?
That's because participants can catch shellfish at these stops.
We chose these two beaches especially for that.
That's very clever, Avery: choosing places where participants can catch shellfish.
I'm sure they'll love this idea.
Anything to add, David?
Only that we're very lucky to have Avery with us!
I know David, we certainly are.
All right, I think we are good for now.
Let’s get to work and prepare the necessary documents.
We'll meet again on Zoom next month, but let’s keep in touch in the meantime.
Goodbye for now.
Goodbye! Goodbye!
